title: "Status, evidence, and provenance"

## What this report establishes {#sec-status}

This is a scientific laboratory of the pre-shell-crossing cold sheet, using nLPT through fourth order and conservative simplex observables. It reproduces the existing numerical core and adds a controlled flat $\Lambda$CDM/EdS PM comparison and directional-derivative laboratory. The scientific motivation is the existing filtered-cosmology evidence described in @sec-published-evidence. Smaller-scale extensions and validated post-crossing LPT dynamics remain outside the scientific claims. Crossed outputs stay visible with orientation diagnostics and a caution.

| Claim or capability | Evidence | Practical limit |
|---|---|---|
| nLPT recurrence through fourth order | Equation residuals, 2LPT closed form, growth tests | Finite Fourier grid and input bandwidth |
| Conservative sheet deposit | Analytic moments, independent R3D fixtures, mass tests | Exact for the represented affine sheet |
| Continuous simplex Fourier modes | Analytic transforms and low-mode deposit comparison | Finite Lagrangian mesh; selected mode coverage |
| PM dynamics | Uniform/plane-wave benchmarks and convergence tests | Finite force mesh and timesteps; matched flat $\Lambda$CDM or EdS background |
| Directional derivatives | Independent centered finite differences | Fixed cosmology and smooth CIC branches; crossing status is diagnostic |
| Published PDF agreement | Packaged original summaries and source metadata | Original filters and small crossing contamination |
| Physical initial modes | EH98 smooth transfer, $\sigma_8$ quadrature and Hermitian/refinement tests | Approximate transfer without BAO or massive neutrinos |
| Optional GPU continuous modes/JVPs | Independent quadrature and complete-request comparisons | f32 precision; weak LPT mode recovery and CPU fallback; device-specific performance |
| Optional resident GPU PM/JVP | Independent DFT force checks and original/quantized Rust PM references | f32 state, CIC and FFT; radix-2 force mesh; independent spatial-field and observation precision |
| Optional GPU centered amplitude check | Independent endpoint integrals, retained Rust f64 comparison, repeat and recovery checks | Compensated f32 arithmetic; bounded endpoint phase gap; CPU fallback |
| Optional GPU nLPT spatial fields | Axis and quadratic solutions, raw Rust-term comparisons and growth-boundary tests | f32 sources/FFT; radix lattice in 2D/3D; CPU growth/time factors |
| Optional GPU exact sheet deposition | Geometric identity, translation, fold and Rust-cell comparisons; conservation gate | f32 cell-local clipping; explicit sliver/capacity recovery |
| Compensated analytic recovery and retained work | Independent simplex quadrature, f64 mode checks, cache invalidation tests | CPU f64 recovery remains available; bounded local cache |
| Higher resolution | Native benchmarks and explicit resource envelope | Browser wall time depends on device; grids are never silently reduced |
| General sub-percent 4LPT accuracy | **Not asserted** | Must specify observable and validation domain |

The [release verification record](https://github.com/yipihey/precrossedsheet/blob/main/docs/verification.md) lists commands actually run and remaining checks. Passing a browser demonstration does not certify inference accuracy; passing a local build does not confirm a deployed GitHub Pages site.

## Lineage and citation

This repository is [yipihey/precrossedsheet](https://github.com/yipihey/precrossedsheet). The interface and publication machinery come from [quadrant](https://github.com/yipihey/quadrant). The original Rust mathematical/geometric core comes from [Hopf–Cole cosmology](https://github.com/yipihey/hopf-cole-cosmology); the archived validation and implementation comparison come from [DiscoDJ.jl](https://github.com/yipihey/DiscoDJ.jl). The [evidence audit](https://github.com/yipihey/precrossedsheet/blob/main/docs/evidence-audit.md) documents the precise scope of the imported claims and code paths.

Cite this implementation using `CITATION.cff`, and cite the primary papers and original studies for the scientific claims. No DOI or precision-performance claim is invented for this implementation.

The footer gives build {{< var build.sha >}} and the build date {{< var build.date >}}. Share the laboratory URL to reproduce its controls; download a full JSON experiment manifest and SVG/CSV/PNG figures. Hypothesis annotations and the repository's issues provide routes for corrections.
